requirements.requirement: Record command ID, exact command, working directory, prerequisite and timeout
Record commit/tree/tag, branch state, environment/tool versions and allowed variable names
Hash fixture, starting state and configuration template without secret values
Capture stdout/stderr, exit status, start/end UTC, expected and actual results
Capture audit, notification, reconciliation, rollback and cleanup evidence
Hash every evidence artifact and deterministic manifest
Record deviations, partial failure and environmental contamination
Require segregated review; drafting function cannot self-close material findings
